name: @obj-codec/benchmark
description: Benchmark suite for obj-codec: throughput, wire size, memory, fidelity, against 14 other serialization libraries.

scripts.bench:all: pnpm bench && pnpm bench:s5 && pnpm bench:stream && pnpm bench:size
scripts.report: tsx report/render.ts results/main.json results/report.md --scaling results/s5-scaling.json --stream results/stream.json --sizes results/library-size.json
